transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As we discussed, we're planning to launch the peer-mediation program for the spring semester, and the current draft proposes twelve student mediators, mediation sessions on Mondays and Wednesdays during lunch, one adult supervisor, and referrals for minor and moderate student conflicts. Before I can give final approval for the operating plan, I need to go through the standard student-services approval checklist. So let's take this one round at a time: peer-mediation advisor, please report on the roster and training status; counselor, please report on referral-screening requirements; and school psychologist, please report on safety and supervision requirements. I'll record your reports and any required plan changes, and then I'll make my final approval decision. Who would like to start?
